notes.title: The FIreshine Games Publisher Sale is live!
notes.notes:
If you love indie games, check out Fireshine’s Steam page for loads of great discounts across their portfolio of titles - including Little Friends at 25% off. From strategy games to co-op adventures, there’s a whole bunch to choose from. There are also a host of great upcoming indie titles that you can show your support for by wishlisting them now! 

The publisher sale kicked off at 6pm BST today and can be found [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/FireshineGamesPublisherSale2023]here[/url]

notes.notes:
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[*] Fixed a crash when attempting to load the Beach during the "Rescue Sparkles" quest

notes.title: Welcome to Puppy Island!
notes.notes:
Get ready for a pawsome puppy adventure on your very own island resort in Little Friends: Puppy Island – the next game in the best-selling Little Friends series. Coming this summer!

Explore a gorgeous island full of hidden treasures, exciting locations, and brand-new puppy pals around every corner. With 9 unique breeds of multiple colour variations to discover, your new best friends can’t wait for you to find them.

[previewyoutube=re79p3H8BGE;full][/previewyoutube]

Expand your holiday resort by building fun new attractions with the help of your little friends. Level up your pups’ stats by training them in obedience, agility, friendliness and more. Show them just how much you love them by bathing, brushing, feeding, walking, and playing with them – making fuzzy friendships to last a lifetime!

Oh, and did we mention you can play dress up? With over 350 outfits and accessories to unlock, your puppies will look the part at home, relaxing at the beach, playing in atop snowy mountains, strolling through beautiful cherry blossom sanctuaries, and more.

We can’t wait for you to visit Puppy Island this summer. Until then, you can find out more about the game and pre-order via our [url=https://littlefriendspuppyisland.com/]official website[/url]. Don’t forget to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/LittleFriendsEN]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/LittleFriendsPuppyIsland/]Facebook[/url], and [url=www.tiktok.com/@littlefriendsen]TikTok[/url], and make sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2172900/Little_Friends_Puppy_Island/]wishlist on Steam[/url]!
